summary: Process-global name-to-factory registry for Backend implementations: register(name, factory), get(name, **config) and names(). get() raises KeyError listing the available names.
extension_points: A third-party Backend registers a factory with register(name, factory) so callers can construct it by name.
lifecycle_notes: The registry starts empty: IbisBackend does not register itself, so get('ibis') raises KeyError unless a caller registers it.
documentation_hooks: Extension guide: registering a non-Ibis backend by name.
risks: No source module imports it and no test exercises it, so its behaviour is unverified and it has no consumer in this package.
Not exported from the package root, so it is reachable only via mountainash_data.core.registry.
open_questions: Is core.registry intended public extension infrastructure (then it needs tests and IbisBackend registration) or a leftover from the multi-backend design that could be retired?

evidence.detail: Not re-exported; grep finds no importer in src or tests
